name: juiceshop-h1
services:
  juice-shop:
    expose:
      - "3000"
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - /nodejs/bin/node
        - -e
        - require('http').get('http://127.0.0.1:3000/',r=>{r.resume();process.exit(r.statusCode===200?0:1)}).on('error',()=>process.exit(1))
      timeout: 5s
      interval: 15s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 1m0s
    image: bkimminich/juice-shop@sha256:877fc77b12d72b42e486eb09b6b1711cc56514306d92006b284e7e7cf076a809
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-file: "3"
        max-size: 10m
    networks:
      interna: null
    restart: unless-stopped
  waf:
    depends_on:
      juice-shop:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      BACKEND: http://juice-shop:3000
      MODSEC_AUDIT_ENGINE: 'On'
      MODSEC_AUDIT_LOG: /dev/stdout
      MODSEC_AUDIT_LOG_FORMAT: JSON
      MODSEC_AUDIT_LOG_PARTS: AHZ
      MODSEC_RULE_ENGINE: DetectionOnly
      PORT: "8080"
      SERVER_NAME: localhost
    image: owasp/modsecurity-crs@sha256:085246dd9bea795b750bac05692adf001cc2c4119767c1639a7c462106a54164
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-file: "3"
        max-size: 10m
    networks:
      entrada: null
      interna: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        host_ip: 127.0.0.1
        target: 8080
        published: "8081"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
networks:
  entrada:
    name: juiceshop-h1_entrada
    driver: bridge
  interna:
    name: juiceshop-h1_interna
    driver: bridge
    internal: true
